query: INSERT INTO import_batch_row (org_id, batch_id, sheet, ordinal, inventory, intent, draft, problems, file_name, state) SELECT $1, $2, r.sheet, r.ordinal, NULLIF(r.inventory, ''), r.intent, r.draft, r.problems, NULLIF(r.file_name, ''), r.state FROM UNNEST($3::text[], $4::int[], $5::text[], $6::text[], $7::jsonb[], $8::jsonb[], $9::text[], $10::text[]) AS r(sheet, ordinal, inventory, intent, draft, problems, file_name, state)
